title: AIVTuber Fault Overlay
description: A versioned fault plan bound to one stream scenario identity (issue #40, consumed by the #70 soak slice). The overlay is a separate document from the scenario on purpose: the scenario format stays consumer-neutral and free of privileged/provider machinery, while provider failures belong to the fault slice. Only subsystems the soak path actually calls may be named, because an injected fault nobody can observe is decoration.

schema_version.description: Fault-overlay document contract version. An incompatible version is refused rather than reinterpreted.

scenario_id.description: The scenario identity this plan was written for. It must match a checked-in scenario exactly; a plan for a similar workload is not a plan for this one.

scenario_version.description: The scenario version this plan was written for. A version bump reshuffles the trace, so an overlay for the old version must not silently apply.

seed.description: Deterministic fault seed, recorded in the soak result identity so two overlays over the same scenario are distinct comparison baselines.

faults.description: Planned injected faults. A subsystem/occurrence pair may appear at most once; occurrence is one-based and counts calls to that subsystem, not events.

subsystem.description: Call point to fail. Only the subsystems the scenario soak actually drives are allowed: content_ingress at each content event's admission, thinking/tts on the generative path a semantic miss would take, and asset_store at each hot-asset insertion.

occurrence.description: One-based call occurrence for this subsystem. The Nth call fails, whatever event index it falls on.

kind.description: Failure mode. The soak degrades the failed step and keeps the deterministic performer advancing; it never freezes.
